title: Vault guns drop from golden enemies, the Overseer and rarely anywhere
why: His answer Q68 (2026-10-18): the vault guns (Longshot, Meridian Lance, Rocket Launcher) also drop from golden enemies and the Overseer, plus a low drop rate anywhere. The golden hoard and the Overseer hoard each gain one vault gun, and any kill has a 1.5 percent chance (3 percent for a hard enemy) to leave one. Math.random, so the seeded stream and the seed 4242 fingerprint do not move.
now: Golden enemies and the Overseer now drop a vault gun, and any kill can rarely leave one.
